events.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
events.heading: An unforgettable night
events.text: We showed the newly released The Devil Wears Prada 2, followed by an incredible music performance by Sema Sole and electrifying sound by Chris Ruti.

events.title: Black Swan
events.heading: A memorable and beautiful first event
events.text: We showed the classic psychological horror film Black Swan and ended the night with an amazing performance by the one and only Sheja Lau.
